conditional_energy_history.local_helper_coverage: The frozen local helper has no windowed term for its second-Compton partition. Its escape-recoil term applies the window to the first recoil; its photoelectric-followup term applies it to full primary energy.
conditional_energy_history.whole_response_limitation: Full Scatter also has intercrystal and collimator terms. This local conditional example does not quantify their overlap, any missing global response fraction, or the cause of the observed 24.02% deficit.

limitations: CPU arithmetic is not a capture of CUDA runtime values. Gaussian probabilities here are conditional reference arithmetic, not measured event fractions. Normalization checks do not bound finite surface/depth/collimator quadrature or missing histories.
